description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants, shown as colored lines with shaded bands around each curve. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. The “Vanilla” curve is purple with a solid line and no markers; it drops steeply from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to roughly 2.65 by around 10,000 iterations, then gradually declines to about 2.46–2.48 by 140,000. “StrmLLM (n=64)” is light blue with a solid line; it starts near 3.4, decreases to about 2.85 around 20,000, and then slowly trends downward to about 2.61–2.62 at 140,000. “SepLLM (n=64)” is orange with a solid line; it falls from near 3.4 to about 2.72–2.74 by ~10,000 and then declines gradually to about 2.52–2.53 at 140,000. “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is green with a solid line; it similarly drops from near 3.4 to about 2.70–2.72 by ~10,000 and then decreases to about 2.50–2.51 by 140,000. “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is red with a solid line; it descends from near 3.4 to about 2.68–2.70 by ~10,000 and then tapers to about 2.49–2.50 at 140,000. “SepLLM (n=128)” is dark blue with a solid line; it starts near 3.4, drops to about 2.69–2.71 by ~10,000, and then gradually decreases to about 2.50–2.51 by 140,000.
